measured_existing.scope: Historical component timings. Synthetic HBM timing models, not measured HBM silicon. Current runtime controller has additional real-join costs; these component numbers cannot replace complete controller envelopes.

arithmetic.actual_controller: Existing adapter invokes both QK and PV per job and discards unused half; two jobs cost 4*16*640*512 MACs. Do not model 2 passes unless a new exact split-job implementation exists.

recommendation.default: Price 4,8,16 aggregate HBM stacks independently of ROM die count. Retain16-stack/TP4 component-calibrated baseline; lower-stack service needs new finite HBM reader/selector composition. Persistent service engines across layers are possible only with query/result transfers and per-layer window state priced.
recommendation.residency: Candidate resident/window resident are opt-in proposal terms, no zero-cost default. Current resident working set has sufficient logical capacity but physical bank shape and protection are unqualified.
recommendation.interconnect: If attention engines centralized on four service dies, every layer must send 64x512 BF16 Q=65536B global, receive 64x512 FP32 PV=131072B global; TP4 rank payloads16384/32768B. Forward compressed owner writes and indexed queries too. Do not silently reuse per-layer co-location links.
